name: Open-Faced Curried Tofu Salad Sandwiches with Lettuce & Cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium carrot
1 stick celery
½ red bell pepper
½ English cucumber
½ head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, nutritional yeast, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup vegan mayonnaise
⅛ cup nutritional yeast flakes
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp rice vinegar
2 tsp curry powder
salt
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp turmeric, ground
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tofu with your fingers into the bowl with the dressing; using a fork, mash to combine the tofu mixture.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrot; add to the bowl with the tofu mixture.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the tofu salad and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and salt. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Arrange bread on the baking sheet and drizzle with garlic oil. Place in the oven and broil until golden brown and toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide toast between plates; top with lettuce, tofu salad, and cucumber slices. Season cucumber with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
